name: リップシンク分析
description: Detects mismatches between lip movements and audio in video to identify deepfake manipulation.
useCase: Detecting face-swapped or lip-synced deepfake videos
mechanism: Extracts lip region from video frames and analyzes the correlation between lip movements and corresponding audio phonemes. AI-generated face swaps often fail to perfectly synchronize lip movements with speech, creating detectable temporal mismatches.
accuracy: High - 80-90% on deepfake videos with audio
source: Haliassos et al. (2021) - Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach to Face Forgery Detection, CVPR
algorithm: Lip Region Extraction + Audio-Visual Correlation + Phoneme Alignment
parameters: Face detection: MTCNN, Lip ROI: 48-68 landmarks, Audio features: MFCC, Correlation window: 200ms
strengths:
• Highly effective for detecting lip-sync deepfakes
• Leverages audio-visual correlation as a strong signal
• Robust against visual-only manipulations
• Works even with low-resolution videos
limitations:
• Requires video with audio track
• Only detects face-related manipulations
• Performance decreases with multiple speakers
• Less effective on silent or music-only videos

references.title: Haliassos, A. et al. (2021). Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach to Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Agarwal, S. et al. (2020). Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Phoneme-Viseme Mismatches. CVPR Workshop.
Zhou, Y. et al. (2021). Joint Audio-Visual Deepfake Detection. ICCV.
